Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ssh

Class VtScreen

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ssh.VtScreen
public final class VtScreen extends Object
A pure, dependency-free VT100/xterm screen-buffer model — the offline-testable core of the SSH terminal. Bytes from the remote shell are fed in and interpreted into a fixed rows x cols grid of VtScreen.Cells with a cursor; the JavaFX terminal view then just paints the grid.

It implements the subset of control codes and CSI/SGR escape sequences that an interactive shell actually leans on: printable text with auto-wrap, CR/LF/BS/TAB/BEL, cursor movement (CUU/CUD/CUF/CUB/ CNL/CPL/CHA/CUP/HVP/VPA), erase-in-display (ED) and erase-in-line (EL), insert/delete/erase char (ICH/DCH/ECH), a scrolling region (DECSTBM) with index/reverse-index scrolling, save/restore cursor, SGR colours (16-colour + bright + xterm-256, bold/inverse/reset), cursor-visibility and the alternate screen buffer (?1049/?1047/?47). OSC (window-title) and unknown sequences are parsed and ignored rather than leaking as garbage. Anything malformed is dropped defensively; the model never throws.
